SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. Station No. D 5799 Date April 11, 1934）
Subject (in full) Bomb throwing incident at the Hong Kong Theatre, 677 N. Szechuen Road, I.O.L.
Made by D.S.I. White Forwarded by

The China Press of the 11th inst., carried a report to the effect that a bomb had been placed in the Hong Kong Theatre, North Szechuen Road, which exploded at about 10.30 p.m. the 10-4-34, resulting in a male and female Chinese receiving injuries.

On perusal of the aforesaid report, D.S.I. White and D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo instituted enquiries at the 1st Station 5th Division, P.S. Bureau, which elicited confirmation of the report and results in the appended information being ascertained in connection thereto.

During the month of April, 1934, the joint proprietors namely, Lok S Daung (陸樹棠) and Doo Yau Daung (杜耀棠) of the Hong Kong Theatre, 677 N. Szechuen Road, I.O.L., have received a series of threatening letters demanding certain sums of money.

In compliance with the contents of the letters the proprietors of the theatre have visited the appointed rendezvous, Kwei Tsung Restaurant, 〔此处转录不清〕 East Wuchang Road, on the instructions of the police of the 1st Station 5th Division, P.S.B., at the schedule times and dates mentioned in the letters, but to date have been unsuccessful in making contact with the writers. The letters are signed in the name of Tsang Ng (張恒) and Lee Him (李炎), which names the police of the Public Safety Bureau believe to be fictitious.

At about 10.30 p.m. on the 10-4-34, whilst the theatrical performance was in progress at the theatre an explosion occurred, resulting in a male Chinese named Yang Tahien Lei (嚴鐵民) and his wife Ying Yong Sa (尹王氏) sustaining slight injuries. The two injured persons were removed to the Foo Ming Hospital, North Szechuen Road, where they received medical treatment and were subsequently discharged.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别课登记室。站点编号 D 5799 日期 1934年4月11日）
事由（全称） 北四川路677号香港大戏院投掷炸弹事件，位于越界筑路区（I.O.L.）。
由 副督察怀特（White）呈报 转呈者

本月11日《字林西报》（The China Press）刊登一则报道，称北四川路香港大戏院内放置了一枚炸弹，该炸弹于1934年4月10日晚10时30分左右爆炸，导致一男一女两名华人受伤。

经查阅上述报道，副督察怀特（White）与副督察范图福（Van Tuh Foo）在公共安全局第五分区第一巡捕房展开调查，证实了该报道属实，并查明了附录中与之相关的信息。

1934年4月期间，位于越界筑路区北四川路677号的香港大戏院的联合业主陆树棠（Lok S Daung）和杜耀棠（Doo Yau Daung）收到一系列勒索信，索要特定数额的金钱。

按照信件内容，戏院业主遵照公共安全局第五分区第一巡捕房警方的指示，在信件中规定的时间和日期，前往指定的会面地点——武昌东路〔此处转录不清〕的桂宗餐厅（Kwei Tsung Restaurant），但至今未能与写信人取得联系。信件署名为张恒（Tsang Ng）和李炎（Lee Him），公共安全局警方认为这些名字是虚构的。

1934年4月10日晚10时30分左右，戏院正在演出期间发生爆炸，导致一名名为严铁民（Yang Tahien Lei）的华籍男子及其妻子尹王氏（Ying Yong Sa）受轻伤。两名伤者被送往北四川路的福民医院（Foo Ming Hospital）接受治疗后出院。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    Misc. File No. 22/34 / 35/34

REPORT    Station, ____
Date ____ 19

Subject (in full)____

Made by____    Forwarded by____

It is learned from the police of the P.S. Bureau that the
bomb was a cigarette tin filled with some type of explosive, which
they are unable to ascertain, and that no material damage was
caused to the building.

At the time of the explosion about 100 persons composed the
audience and that very little commotion occurred over the incident

The performance was resumed about five minutes after the
incident.

An offer was made to the police of the 1st Station 5th
Division, P.S. Bureau, to co-operate in pursuing investigations
pertaining to the perpetrators of the offence. This offer was
politely refused, with the information that should the services
of the Municipal Police be required, they will communicate with
Dixwell Road Station for assistance.

R. J. White
D. S. I.

D. D. O. [签字] /

O/C Special Branch.

报告 巡捕房，____
日期 ____ 19__

事由（全称）____

呈报人____ 转呈者____

据公共安全局警方获悉，
该炸弹是一个装填有某种类型炸药的香烟罐，具体种类他们无法确定，且建筑物未遭受实质性损坏。

爆炸发生时观众约有100人，事件并未引起太大骚动。

事发约五分钟后，演出恢复进行。

有人向公共安全局第五分区第一巡捕房警方提出协助追查罪犯的建议。该建议被礼貌拒绝，并被告知如需工部局警务处提供服务，他们将联系狄思威路（Dixwell Road）巡捕房寻求协助。

R. J. 怀特（White）
副督察

C. S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5799
Date 11 / 4 / 34

April 11, 1934. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :

BOMB EXPLOSION AT HONGKONG THEATRE

The Hongkong Theatre (香港大戲院) off North
Szechuen Road stages Cantonese dramas only and is a very
prosperous concern.
Recently the manager of the theatre received
three threatening letters from certain loafers demanding
money, but the manager paid no heed to the letters.
However at about 11 p.m. yesterday while a
performance was in progress, two bombs were thrown from
the third class stalls.
The bombs exploded, patrons ran for their
lives and the bomb throwers made good their escape. Two
patrons received serious injuries and were later removed
to the Foh Ming (福民) Hospital.
The 5th District Police of the Public Safety
Bureau sent a large party of police to the scene. The
threatening letters were handed over to the police who
are now making efforts to arrest the loafers.

编号 D 5799
日期 1934年4月11日

1934年4月11日。晨间译文。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

香港大戏院炸弹爆炸事件

位于北四川路附近的香港大戏院（Hongkong Theatre）仅上演粤剧，生意十分兴隆。
近期，戏院经理收到几封来自某些无业游民的勒索信，但经理未予理会。
然而，昨晚11时许，演出正在进行时，两枚炸弹从三等座席区域被投出。
炸弹爆炸，观众四散奔逃，投弹者趁机逃脱。两名观众受重伤，随后被送往福民医院（Foh Ming Hospital）。
公共安全局第五区警方派遣大批警员赶赴现场。勒索信已移交警方，警方正努力逮捕这些无业游民。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
April 11 No. D 5794
Date 11 / 4 / 34

Miscellaneous (2)

Shanghai Municipality Electric Supply Trade Association
- circular telegram in furtherance of national goods
movement

On April 10, the above mentioned association,
580 Yoeh Jen Li, Yunnan Road, despatched a circular
telegram to chambers of Commerce and trade associations
throughout the nation. The telegram explains that both
foreign and Chinese electric light bulbs are manufactured
in Shanghai and that the only difference between them is
the trade mark. It finally exhorts the public to use
Chinese bulbs which are comparatively cheaper.

Bomb Explosion in Hongkong Theatre, North Szechuen Road
O.O.L.

At 10.30 p.m. April 10, a hand grenade exploded on
the ground floor of the Hongkong Theatre, No.683 North
Szechuen Road O.O.L. during a cinema performance. It
is reported that two members of the audience were injured.

〔此处为手写签名〕
Supt.
for Officer i/c Special Branch.

4月11日 编号 D 5794
日期 1934年4月11日

杂项（2）

上海市电气供应同业公会
- 关于提倡国货运动的通函电报

4月10日，上述协会通过位于云南路悦仁里580号的办事处，向全国各地的商会和同业公会发出通函电报。电报指出，外国和中国制造的电灯泡均在上海生产，两者唯一的区别在于商标。最后呼吁公众使用价格相对低廉的中国灯泡。

北四川路香港大戏院炸弹爆炸事件
位于越界筑路区（O.O.L.）

4月10日晚10时30分，位于越界筑路区北四川路683号的香港大戏院一楼在放映电影期间，一枚手榴弹爆炸。据报道，两名观众受伤。

〔此处为手写签名〕
警司
代特别课主管
